propositions: A PreToolUse hook on the Bash tool must emit a short reminder (2-3 lines) when grep-family commands (grep, rg, egrep, fgrep) are invoked, preferring Serena's symbol tools while acknowledging legitimate grep use cases (string literals, line numbers).
The hook trigger must be a simple grep-family string match in the command with no pattern classification or path heuristics, accepting false positives to avoid missing the intended behavior.
The hook must be non-blocking, informing via hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext in JSON format without emitting permissionDecision, allowing the grep command to execute normally.

The hook script must be implemented in scripts/hooks/serena_grep_reminder.py as a tracked, testable file, and integrated into .claude/settings.json without overwriting the existing env.ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH setting from story C.
The hook must never exit non-zero and must gracefully handle malformed input (empty stdin, absent command, non-JSON stdin) without denying calls or suppressing permission prompts.
Automated tests must verify the hook fires on grep and rg commands, does not fire on non-grep commands, and confirms the JSON output contains additionalContext with no permissionDecision.
